```plato

    // Chain three elemental rotations in the given application order (the
    // first-listed axis applies first, about fixed world axes). The receiver
    // is the order because the TIR body writer currently grounds a match only
    // when its subject is a bare parameter.
    ChainRotations(order: RotationOrder, aboutX: Quaternion, aboutY: Quaternion, aboutZ: Quaternion): Quaternion =>
        match (order) {
            XYZ => aboutX.Concatenate(aboutY).Concatenate(aboutZ);
            XZY => aboutX.Concatenate(aboutZ).Concatenate(aboutY);
            YXZ => aboutY.Concatenate(aboutX).Concatenate(aboutZ);
            YZX => aboutY.Concatenate(aboutZ).Concatenate(aboutX);
            ZXY => aboutZ.Concatenate(aboutX).Concatenate(aboutY);
            ZYX => aboutZ.Concatenate(aboutY).Concatenate(aboutX);
        };
```
